title: Lost Identity
summary: Humphrey's Aunt Mary visits the island and witnesses a man fall to his death at the hotel.
method: The killer leveraged the switch-over of the CCTV discs to commit the murder. He had already left the door open when he delivered food to that room earlier so it didn't register in his card swipe history. He tried to grab the bag from the victim and in the process, the victim fell over the balcony. The killer then returned to his desk and changed the clock time so on CCTV it would show as 2am when it was really 2:10am.
motive: The killer recognized the hotel guest as a prominent criminal who was assuming a false identity. The criminal had served 6 years in jail for accounting fraud and returned to Saint Marie supposedly to retrieve money he embezzled before his imprisonment. The killer eavesdropped in the next room and found out about this plan and decided to act fact because the guest was going to check out the next day.
notes: I thought it was protocol not to discuss case details with non-police. It's weird that Humphrey works out the case details with Aunt Mary.
